news.title: Man injured in northeast Atlanta shooting, police investigate
news.summary: A 22-year-old man is hospitalized after being shot by an unknown suspect in northeast Atlanta, with police continuing to investigate the incident.

news.title: Police seek driver in fatal southwest Atlanta hit-and-run
news.summary: A 23-year-old woman is dead after being struck in a hit-and-run on I-75 in Atlanta. Police are investigating as the driver fled the scene on foot.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man sentenced to life after 2021 murder conviction
news.summary: A Clayton County jury has made a conviction in the 2021 shooting death of a man at a local townhome.

news.title: Atlanta police arrest suspect after Cheshire Bridge Road shooting
news.summary: Atlanta police have arrested a 23-year-old man after a shooting Saturday morning on Cheshire Bridge Road.

news.title: WATCH: Suspect caught crawling from Atlanta home after alleged copper wire theft
news.summary: Police have released video showing the arrest of a man accused of stealing copper wire from a southwest Atlanta home.

news.title: Shooting that hurt man stemmed from argument, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police said in an update Saturday that a 36-year-old man was taken to Grady Memorial Hospital.

news.title: Man wanted in brutal Clayton County tattoo shop assault caught in Minnesota
news.summary: A man wanted in connection with a violent gang-related assault and robbery at a Clayton County tattoo parlor has been captured in Minnesota after more than a year on the run, authorities said.

news.title: Man injured after verbal dispute leads to southwest Atlanta shooting
news.summary: A late-night verbal argument erupted into violence in southwest Atlanta's Perkerson neighborhood on Friday, sending a 36-year-old man to the hospital, according to police.

news.title: Man hospitalized after overnight shooting in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A 20-year-old man is recovering in the hospital after being shot multiple times early Saturday morning in the Collier Heights neighborhood, according to police.

news.title: Driver killed after crashing into parked tractor-trailer on I-75, police say
news.summary: A 26-year-old Cartersville man was killed early Saturday morning after his vehicle drifted out of his lane and collided with a parked tractor-trailer along I-75 in Cobb County, according to police.

news.title: Woman dies after stepping into I-85 traffic following dispute, police say
news.summary: A 26-year-old woman died Saturday after stepping into traffic along Interstate 85 following a physical fight inside a vehicle, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Driver killed in fiery I-20 crash after possible tire blowout, police say
news.summary: A 54-year-old man died following a single-car crash and fire early Saturday morning along I-20 in Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Victim dies in Riverdale shooting, suspect in custody
news.summary: The Clayton County Police Department says a man died after being shot in Riverdale Friday night.

news.title: Suspect charged with aggravated assault after Northeast Atlanta shooting
news.summary: A 23-year-old man faces charges of aggravated assault after a shooting at an Atlanta adult store. Police report security fired at James Jenkins before his arrest.

news.title: Guard shoots 23-year-old who shot man at Atlanta adult store, police say

news.title: Man killed, person in custody after shooting in Riverdale, police say
news.summary: A man is dead, and a person is in custody after a shooting in Riverdale on Friday night, according to the Clayton County Police Department.
